profile.name: Ram Si
profile.headline: Curious builder, competitive coder and badminton player who likes turning ideas into things people use.
profile.bio: I'm a 16-year-old student who can't stop asking "what if?". I spend my week writing code, building small robots, practising badminton at 6 AM and playing Chopin when nobody is listening. I believe the best way to learn something is to build it, break it and build it again, and I love explaining what I learn to younger students.
funFacts: Solved 400+ problems on competitive programming sites
Can solve a Rubik's cube in under 40 seconds
Runs a weekend coding club for 25 middle-schoolers

achievements.title: IRIS National Science Fair: Grand Award
achievements.description: Built 'AquaSense', a ₹900 IoT device that monitors water quality in village tanks and sends SMS alerts when contamination spikes. Tested for 3 months across 4 villages.

achievements.title: Indian National Olympiad in Informatics
achievements.description: Qualified for the IOI training camp after placing among the top 30 of 12,000+ participants nationwide.

achievements.title: Asia-Pacific Youth Hackathon
achievements.description: Led a team of 4 to build 'StudyBuddy', an accessibility-first study planner for students with dyslexia, in 36 hours.

achievements.title: State U-17 Badminton Championship
achievements.description: Reached the final after winning 5 straight matches, including a comeback from 11–19 in the semi-final.

achievements.title: Trinity College London: Grade 7 Piano
achievements.description: Scored 91/100 with distinction; performed Chopin's Nocturne Op. 9 No. 2.

achievements.title: Regional Mathematics Olympiad
achievements.description: Top scorer in the region; qualified for INMO.

achievements.title: District Science Exhibition
achievements.description: Demonstrated a solar-powered seed dryer made from recycled materials for local farmers.

achievements.title: Elected School Vice-Captain
achievements.description: Elected by 1,200 students and staff. Started a peer-tutoring programme that paired 80 students.

achievements.title: Inter-school Debate Championship
achievements.description: Argued for the motion 'AI should be taught from primary school'.

achievements.title: National Young Artists Contest
achievements.description: Digital illustration 'The City That Breathes' selected among the top 100 entries.

achievements.title: School Coding Cup
achievements.description: My first competition win, which started the whole journey.

projects.title: AquaSense
projects.summary: Low-cost IoT water-quality monitor for rural water tanks.
projects.description: ESP32 + TDS/turbidity/pH sensors, solar powered, SMS alerts over GSM. Deployed in 4 villages with the help of a local NGO. Won the national science fair grand award.

projects.title: StudyBuddy
projects.summary: Accessibility-first study planner for students with dyslexia.
projects.description: Dyslexia-friendly fonts, text-to-speech, and a spaced-repetition scheduler. Built at the APAC Youth Hackathon and now used by 300+ students.

projects.title: Shuttle Tracker
projects.summary: Computer-vision tool that analyses my badminton footwork.
projects.description: Uses OpenCV + MediaPipe on phone video to plot court coverage heatmaps. My coach now uses it with the whole academy.

projects.title: Night Sky Almanac
projects.summary: A tiny web app that tells you what's visible in tonight's sky.
projects.description: Pulls ephemeris data and renders an interactive star chart for your location.

activities.description: Teaching Scratch and Python to 25 middle-schoolers every Saturday.
Launched a peer-tutoring programme and a zero-waste canteen drive.
Monthly river-bank clean-ups and water-testing drives.

goals.title: Qualify for the International Olympiad in Informatics

testimonials.quote: Ram is the rare student who asks the second question, the one that makes the whole class stop and think. His AquaSense project showed real engineering maturity.
testimonials.author: Dr. Meera Iyer

testimonials.quote: Calm under pressure, generous with his teammates, and relentless about details. He led our hackathon team like a professional.
testimonials.author: Rahul Menon
testimonials.role: Hackathon mentor, APAC Youth Tech Forum

testimonials.quote: He trains before sunrise and still shows up to help the juniors. That tells you everything.
testimonials.author: Coach Sunil Rao
